anomalies.observed: PCA9685PW pin 1 (A0) is on net +3.3V, while A1 through A5 (pins 2, 3, 4, 5, 24) are on GND. With A0 high the 7-bit I2C address is 0x41, not the 0x40 the spec requires.
anomalies.expected: The spec lists the PCA9685PW at I2C address 0x40, which requires A0 to be strapped to GND like the other address pins.

evidence.quote: NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40 | `FCCPeripherals.sch` note "PWM Driver"

anomalies.impact: The servo PWM driver would answer at 0x41 instead of 0x40, so firmware addressing it at 0x40 gets no response and servo outputs cannot be commanded. The INA219 is also at 0x40 on the same SDA/SCL bus, so the strapping conflicts with the spec as written.

parsed.summary: U15 (PCA9685PW) has its A0 address pin tied to +3.3V while the other address pins are tied to GND, which shifts its I2C address to 0x41 instead of the specified 0x40. The rest of the netlist is noisy, so I report this single, most concrete deviation.
